issue: #1923 (Lane C2: PullCursorAtomicity over #1895 Lane B3 SOURCE-CAPTURE-1)

models.scope: SOURCE-CAPTURE-1 durable source-sync lease fencing, atomic complete-page inbox + pending + cursor persistence in one SQLite transaction, exact full-page idempotent replay vs conflicting-digest refusal, and post-commit crash recovery (crates/norn-cell/src/source_cursor.rs, crates/norn-cell/src/mapping_page.rs, crates/norn-api/src/host/source_capture.rs)
assumptions: A1 SQLite write_tx is atomic and durable on commit and rolls back completely on error or crash before commit.
A2 Logical/wall clock now_ms is monotonically non-decreasing across ticks on the single cell.
A3 Page content digests (norn.source.page.v2) are collision-free across distinct page payloads or cursor transitions.
A4 At most MAX_FAULTS (2) store/crash faults occur in one bounded trace.

variants.meaning: M1: capture omits active lease (owner, generation, expiry) check, allowing an expired or superseded worker to advance the cursor
M2: _norn_source_cursor commits outside the inbox transaction, leaving the cursor advanced without captured inbox rows after a pre-commit fault
M3: duplicate page delivery bypasses IdempotentReplay and writes duplicate rows into _norn_inbox
M4: _norn_source_pending is cleared during a post-commit ledger fault before canonical landing succeeds, stranding captured rows
M5: release_source_lease ignores (lease_id, generation), letting a stale worker expire a newer active worker's lease
M6: release deletes the lease row instead of zeroing expires_at_ms, resetting fencing generation back to 1 on next acquire

notProved: Bounded model check: covers 2 competing workers, 1 connection, 1 dataset, 3 sequential pages, logical time 0..6, TTL 2, and up to 2 faults; unbounded runs and multi-dataset interactions are not proved by Apalache.

Conformance is state-machine and SQLite mutant replay against real CellStore/DevHost SQLite transactions (crates/norn-api/tests/pull_cursor_atomicity_quint.rs), not a mechanized Rust-to-Quint refinement proof.

Nonterminal multi-page cursor progression and OBS-LINK-DISPUTE-1 one-by-one fallback are exercised in Rust SQLite conformance tests rather than modeled as separate sub-page states inside this bounded Quint model.
